title: Nasi Goreng Pukul Sebelas
subject: a man who wakes his wife at eleven at night because he has made nasi goreng kampung with too much cili padi for no reason at all, and they eat it on the kitchen floor
caption: Malay new jack swing love song in the late-1980s lineage. Swung drum-machine beat with hard snare, popping slap bass line, bell-tone FM electric piano chords, short brass stabs, muted funk rhythm guitar. Polished late-80s studio sheen, wide stereo. Male lead tenor, smooth and clearly sung with confident short runs, female backing harmonies on the chorus. Clear full voice, every word enunciated, steady sung melody on every line. 104 BPM, A-flat major. Warm late-night domestic romance. No trap drums, no autotune, no rap break, no modern EDM bass, no ballad slowdown.
lyrics:
[Intro - drum machine, slap bass, brass stab]
[Verse 1]
Pukul sebelas, dapur masih terang
Aku goreng nasi semalam
Bawang putih, ikan bilis, telur dua
Cili padi terlebih segenggam
[Pre-Chorus]
Sayang, bangun sekejap
Tak ada sebab, aku cuma nak makan dengan kau
[Chorus]
Nasi goreng pukul sebelas
Duduk atas lantai dapur
Kau tiup sudu, kau marah pedas
Tapi pinggan kau dah licin dulu
[Verse 2]
Rambut kau kusut, baju tidur senget
Kau curi telur dari pinggan aku
Air sejuk habis satu jag
Kau ketawa sampai tersedu
[Pre-Chorus]
Esok kerja, mata berat
Tapi malam ni kita tak berkira
[Chorus]
Nasi goreng pukul sebelas
Lampu dapur kuning malap
Kau kata lain kali kurang pedas
Lain kali kau minta tambah lagi
[Outro - brass stabs, backing harmonies]
Pinggan dua dalam sinki
Kita basuh esok pagi
